      allOf:

            timezone:

            memberId:

              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year

                memberId — the fiscal year the business-day-adjusted registrationDate falls in. The

              readOnly: true

              title: Possible duplicate of

              example: 1

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` line 8 sets the OpenAPI doc `version: '1.0'`; the many "An ID for this version of the response" entries are unrelated header descriptions. components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Drives the derived
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility, and
            also returned: on return it is the composed address — the normalized 'addressLine1' with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
            An owner must supply an address in either form: a non-blank 'addressLine1' or this flat
            'address', plus 'city'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address'
            when present. Normalized like 'address' (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, upper-cased,
            street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized like
            'addressLine1'; when present it is appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and brackets and an
            optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by
            8 to 15 digits). A national number without a '+' assumes country code '+61' and drops a
            single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the city's
            region per the fixed table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present, drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only override for create. The household is keyed on (lastName, postcode); when an
            existing owner shares this owner's lastName and postcode the request is rejected with 409,
            unless sharesHousehold is true, in which case the owner is created as a declared household
            member (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate). Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as 'title lastName' (the title, a single space, then
                the lastName) when a title is given, or just the lastName when no title is present.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), the REGION prefix of the memberId
                ('<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'); 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode yields no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality (region), from the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane); null when the region is absent or unknown.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the region code
                derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else 'UNKNOWN'), FY the two-digit fiscal year
                the business-day-adjusted registrationDate falls in (fiscal year starting 1 July),
                HASH8 the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone +
                lastName, and CHK a single Luhn check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
                A collision with an existing owner's member id is de-duplicated by appending '-<n>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the two-digit FY segment of the
                memberId — the fiscal year the business-day-adjusted registrationDate falls in. The
                fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends. Null
                when the memberId is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners of the same household: the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized lastName and postcode. Owners with the same
                lastName and postcode resolve to the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3A7F9C2E1B0D'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived key: the SHA-256 hex (lower-case, 64 characters) over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where email is the lower-cased
                email or empty. Duplicate detection is expressed entirely through this key.
              type: string
              example: '5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c5920'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, already
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the
                owner's name was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when
                namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for tenure of one or more
                elapsed fiscal years (fiscal year starting 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4, derived by banding membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3, level 3 for 4-5, level 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, computed from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR'
                (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Null when birthDate is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's business
                day at the moment it was created (a bulk sign-up); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, its city already held between 40
                and 49 owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, an existing owner shared this
                owner's lastName and postcode but had a different telephone (a soft match that is
                still created rather than rejected); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of, when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true; null otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when any of these hold: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' true), the email domain is disposable-adjacent (a domain
                that shares a base name with a known disposable-email provider but is not itself
                on the blocklist, e.g. 'mailinator.net' or 'sub.tempmail.com'), or the city is
                over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' true); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false. DELETE
                /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true) while retaining the record, and the
                create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URL of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>' where id is the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: Leo
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2010-09-07'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PetAgeValidation"
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetType'
      required:
        - name
        - birthDate
        - type
    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - id
            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:
      title: VetFields
      description: Editable fields of a veterinarian.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: 'James'
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: 'Carter'
        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Specialty'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    Vet:
      title: Vet
      description: A veterinarian.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the vet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
      required:
        - id
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:
      title: Visit fields
      description: Editable fields of a vet visit.
      type: object
      properties:
        date:
          title: Date
          description: The date of the visit.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        description:
          title: Description
          description: The description for the visit.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'rabies shot'
      required:
        - description
    Visit:
      title: Visit
      description: A booking for a vet visit.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VisitFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the visit.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            petId:
              title: Pet ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
            - petId
    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username
    Role:
      title: Role
      description: A role.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin
      required:
        - name

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

    delete:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: deleteOwner
      summary: Delete an owner by ID
      description: Returns the owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner  not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}/pets:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addPetToOwner
      summary: Adds a pet to an owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Drives the derived
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility, and
            also returned: on return it is the composed address — the normalized 'addressLine1' with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
            An owner must supply an address in either form: a non-blank 'addressLine1' or this flat
            'address', plus 'city'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address'
            when present. Normalized like 'address' (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, upper-cased,
            street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized like
            'addressLine1'; when present it is appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and brackets and an
            optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by
            8 to 15 digits). A national number without a '+' assumes country code '+61' and drops a
            single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the city's
            region per the fixed table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present, drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only override for create. The household is keyed on (lastName, postcode); when an
            existing owner shares this owner's lastName and postcode the request is rejected with 409,
            unless sharesHousehold is true, in which case the owner is created as a declared household
            member (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate). Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner response shape. Fixed at 2: the memberId, identityKey and
                householdId are grouped under the nested 'identity' object rather than at the top level.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as 'title lastName' (the title, a single space, then
                the lastName) when a title is given, or just the lastName when no title is present.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), the REGION prefix of the memberId
                ('<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'); 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode yields no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality (region), from the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane); null when the region is absent or unknown.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the region code
                derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else 'UNKNOWN'), FY the two-digit fiscal year
                the business-day-adjusted registrationDate falls in (fiscal year starting 1 July),
                HASH8 the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone +
                lastName, and CHK a single Luhn check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
                A collision with an existing owner's member id is de-duplicated by appending '-<n>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the two-digit FY segment of the
                memberId — the fiscal year the business-day-adjusted registrationDate falls in. The
                fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends. Null
                when the memberId is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners of the same household: the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized lastName and postcode. Owners with the same
                lastName and postcode resolve to the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3A7F9C2E1B0D'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived key: the SHA-256 hex (lower-case, 64 characters) over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where email is the lower-cased
                email or empty. Duplicate detection is expressed entirely through this key.
              type: string
              example: '5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c5920'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, already
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the
                owner's name was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when
                namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for tenure of one or more
                elapsed fiscal years (fiscal year starting 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4, derived by banding membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3, level 3 for 4-5, level 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, computed from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR'
                (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Null when birthDate is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's business
                day at the moment it was created (a bulk sign-up); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, its city already held between 40
                and 49 owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, an existing owner shared this
                owner's lastName and postcode but had a different telephone (a soft match that is
                still created rather than rejected); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of, when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true; null otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when any of these hold: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' true), the email domain is disposable-adjacent (a domain
                that shares a base name with a known disposable-email provider but is not itself
                on the blocklist, e.g. 'mailinator.net' or 'sub.tempmail.com'), or the city is
                over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' true); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false. DELETE
                /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true) while retaining the record, and the
                create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URL of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>' where id is the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page

          type: integer

          minimum: 0

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:

          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

        page:

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size

              $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: User created successfully.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: User not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Drives the derived
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility, and
            also returned: on return it is the composed address — the normalized 'addressLine1' with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
            An owner must supply an address in either form: a non-blank 'addressLine1' or this flat
            'address', plus 'city'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address'
            when present. Normalized like 'address' (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, upper-cased,
            street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized like
            'addressLine1'; when present it is appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and brackets and an
            optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by
            8 to 15 digits). A national number without a '+' assumes country code '+61' and drops a
            single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the city's
            region per the fixed table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present, drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only override for create. The household is keyed on (lastName, postcode); when an
            existing owner shares this owner's lastName and postcode the request is rejected with 409,
            unless sharesHousehold is true, in which case the owner is created as a declared household
            member (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate). Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner response shape. Fixed at 2: the memberId, identityKey and
                householdId are grouped under the nested 'identity' object rather than at the top level.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as 'title lastName' (the title, a single space, then
                the lastName) when a title is given, or just the lastName when no title is present.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), the REGION prefix of the memberId
                ('<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'); 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode yields no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality (region), from the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane); null when the region is absent or unknown.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the two-digit FY segment of the
                memberId — the fiscal year the business-day-adjusted registrationDate falls in. The
                fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends. Null
                when the memberId is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners of the same household: the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized lastName and postcode. Owners with the same
                lastName and postcode resolve to the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3A7F9C2E1B0D'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived key: the SHA-256 hex (lower-case, 64 characters) over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where email is the lower-cased
                email or empty. Duplicate detection is expressed entirely through this key.
              type: string
              example: '5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c5920'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, already
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the
                owner's name was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when
                namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for tenure of one or more
                elapsed fiscal years (fiscal year starting 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4, derived by banding membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3, level 3 for 4-5, level 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, computed from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR'
                (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Null when birthDate is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's business
                day at the moment it was created (a bulk sign-up); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, its city already held between 40
                and 49 owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, an existing owner shared this
                owner's lastName and postcode but had a different telephone (a soft match that is
                still created rather than rejected); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of, when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true; null otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when any of these hold: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' true), the email domain is disposable-adjacent (a domain
                that shares a base name with a known disposable-email provider but is not itself
                on the blocklist, e.g. 'mailinator.net' or 'sub.tempmail.com'), or the city is
                over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' true); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false. DELETE
                /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true) while retaining the record, and the
                create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URL of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>' where id is the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identifiers, grouped together: the member id, the identity key and the
        household id. Every value is re-derived under version 2 by mixing in a fixed 'V2' version tag,
        so none matches its version-1 form. The version tag appears only inside these identifiers, never
        in the user-facing locality, timezone or owner segment.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member id
          description: >-
            The owner's member id, formatted '<REGIONV2><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGIONV2 is the region code
            derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else 'UNKNOWN') with the fixed 'V2' version tag
            appended (e.g. 'NSWV2'), FY the two-digit fiscal year the business-day-adjusted
            registrationDate falls in (fiscal year starting 1 July), HASH8 the first 8 upper-case hex
            characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + lastName, and CHK a single Luhn check digit
            over the digits of '<REGIONV2><FY><HASH8>'. A collision with an existing owner's member id is
            de-duplicated by appending '-<n>'.
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV2271A2B3C4D5'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A deterministic identifier shared by owners of the same household: the first 12 hex
            characters of SHA-256 over the fixed 'V2' version tag, the normalized lastName and postcode.
            Owners with the same lastName and postcode resolve to the same value automatically.
          type: string
          example: '3A7F9C2E1B0D'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            A derived key: the SHA-256 hex (lower-case, 64 characters) over
            'V2|normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where email is the lower-cased email
